label: Formal Garden
literalRoomDescription: This is the middle part of a formal garden. Hedges hide the cavern walls and a dim illumination comes from mosses far above. The path is of small crushed white stones. It winds among bushes and flower beds from south to north. To the north a small structure can be seen. To the south are peculiarly shaped bushes. There is a small gap in the hedges to the west.
safeSceneProfile: Middle of a formal garden inside a cavern. Hedges conceal the cavern walls; dim moss light comes from far above. A crushed white-stone path winds through bushes and flower beds from south to north, with a small western hedge gap. A modest distant structure is visible northward. There is no sky or sunlight. Global unicorn references remain interaction aliases and must not create a permanently placed unicorn. Flowers are decorative, with no added collectible or readable clues.

label: North End of Garden
literalRoomDescription: This is the northern end of a formal garden. Hedges hide the cavern walls, and if you don't look up, the illusion is of a cloudy day outside. The light comes from a large growth of glowing mosses on the roof of the cave. A break in the hedge is almost overgrown to the north. A carefully manicured path leads south. In the center of a rosebed is a small open structure, painted white. It appears to be a gazebo.
safeSceneProfile: Cave-roof moss creates cloudy-day illusion above hedges; white gazebo in central rosebed, overgrown northern hedge gap and manicured southern path. No actual sky.

label: Gazebo
literalRoomDescription: This is a gazebo in the midst of a formal garden. It is cool and restful here. A tea table adorns the center of the gazebo.
safeSceneProfile: Cool white gazebo within the cave garden, with separate tea table. No tea-table contents or unicorn unless currently observed.

label: Topiary
literalRoomDescription: This is the southern end of a formal garden. Hedges hide the cavern walls and mosses provide dim illumination. Fantastically shaped hedges and bushes are arrayed with geometric precision. They have not recently been clipped, but you can discern creatures in the shapes of the bushes: There is a dragon, a unicorn, a great serpent, a huge misshapen dog, and several human figures. On the west side of the garden the path leads through a rose arbor into a tunnel.
safeSceneProfile: Moss-lit cave garden with geometrically placed overgrown bushes shaped as dragon, unicorn, serpent, huge misshapen dog and humans; west rose arbor. These silhouettes are not live actors.
